BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TIME_QUEEN_BLESSING_REL: Upon pickup, choose a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [gold]Replay[/gold].
Winterbell lies in the distant past. This is the homeland of the White Queen.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_STAGNANT_GEAR_RELIC.des: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Stagnant Gear[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_STAGNANT_GEAR_RELIC.fla: Your gears are not turning? You should have gears inside your head.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SILVER_KEY_RELIC.title: Silver Key
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SILVER_KEY_RELIC.descri: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [gold]Unlock[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SILVER_KEY_RELIC.select: Choose a card to enchant with Unlock.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SILVER_KEY_RELIC.flavor: My key can fit into and open any door.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MABEL_SOLDIER_RELIC.des: During Act 1, all enchantable Common and Uncommon cards in card rewards are [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [gold]Ascension[/gold]. Ascension cards transform after [blue]7[/blue] nodes. Rare cards are not enchanted.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MABEL_SOLDIER_RELIC.fla: A game played on a board? Then I am rather good at it.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GUIGNOLS_DOLL_RELIC.des: Gain applause and boos based on combat performance. At [blue]{RequiredReactions}[/blue] review score, gain [gold]Popularity Surge[/gold]. At [blue]-{RequiredReactions}[/blue] review score, gain [gold]Popularity Slump[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GUIGNOLS_DOLL_RELIC.det: Gain [gold]applause[/gold] for a splendid, brutal, or flawless performance. Gain [gold]boos[/gold] when the act falls flat, when you suffer badly, when you are left in danger, or when an enemy limps through the end of your turn. The counter shows applause minus boos.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GUIGNOLS_DOLL_RELIC.fla: He pulls the strings, and the audience applauds. When the performance fails, the other end tightens around the actor's neck.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PINOCCHIO_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Pinocchio
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PINOCCHIO_RELIC.descrip: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} with a damage or Block value. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [gold]Lie[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PINOCCHIO_RELIC.selecti: Choose a card to enchant with Lie.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PINOCCHIO_RELIC.flavor: The body was disassembled, and the soul was unreasonably sewn into a doll. Anyone who traces that memory would naturally come to hate that selfish god.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_THROUGH_LOOKING_G: Alice in Wonderland 2: Through the Looking-Glass

Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [gold]Ascension[/gold]. Ascension cards transform after [blue]7[/blue] nodes. The next Act's map becomes [blue]3[/blue] straight routes with no branches.
Choose four cards to enchant with Ascension.
On the other side of the mirror, the girl became queen.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_THREE_LITTLE_PIGS_RELIC: Fairy Tale - The Three Little Pigs
Gain no rewards for the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] {Combats:plural:combat|combats}.
The monster raised by the pigs devoured all three little pigs when they had nowhere left to run. The ruined farm became a new home for hungry hyenas.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_EMPERORS_NEW_CLOTHES_RE: Fairy Tale - The Emperor's New Clothes
On the second turn of each combat, you cannot gain any [gold]Block[/gold].
Everyone praised the clothes that did not exist, until the wind touched bare skin.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICUXELS_DOG_RELIC.des: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{FeelNoPainPower}[/blue] [gold]Feel No Pain[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICUXELS_DOG_RELIC.fla: The faithful dog had long protected the owner it loved: from beasts, from disease, and from the foolish church that tried to offer its beloved master as a sacrifice.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SONG_OF_BONE_RELIC.desc: At the start of combat, play [gold]Dirge[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SONG_OF_BONE_RELIC.flav: ♪ The flute you play is my bone. My brother wanted to marry the princess, so he killed me and buried me. ♪
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FROG_PRINCESS_RELIC.des: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards that can receive [gold]Dissolve[/gold] with [gold]Dissolve[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FROG_PRINCESS_RELIC.fla: A prince of a certain kingdom accidentally dropped his boot into a swamp. A giant frog emerged from that place, forced a kiss on the prince, and then murdered him. "Ah... this man was not my prince either..."
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FOX_AND_SOUR_GRAPES_REL: Fairy Tale - The Fox and the Sour Grapes
At the start of combat, all creatures gain [blue]{EnvenomPower}[/blue] [gold]Envenom[/gold].
The fruit on that tree looks sour and surely tastes terrible. When harvest comes, I will see the bitter faces of those who eat it. I only need to guard it until then.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PIED_PIPER_OF_HAMELIN_R: Fairy Tale - The Pied Piper of Hamelin
At the start of combat, gain [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
The man was persecuted by his neighbors because of poverty. So he decided to take revenge. With his flute, he drove the rats to spread disease everywhere, and in the end the town was destroyed.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_JACK_AND_THE_BEANSTALK_: Fairy Tale - Jack and the Beanstalk
After each node, lose [blue]{Health}[/blue] HP, down to a minimum of [blue]1[/blue]. On the [blue]{Nodes}[/blue]th node, gain Max HP equal to the total lost, then this relic becomes inactive.
There was a poor boy who was abandoned by his mother together with the beans. Tormented by hunger, the boy ate the beans, and they began to grow at a visible speed.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALADDIN_AND_THE_MAGIC_L: Fairy Tale - Aladdin and the Magic Lamp
At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
"I can grant any wish you desire," said the genie. Aladdin answered, "Give me your power."
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BEAUTY_AND_THE_BEAST_RE: Fairy Tale - Beauty and the Beast
At the start of combat, spend [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold to gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. If you cannot afford it, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
Beauty used the Beast to gain status and wealth. The Beast fell in love with Beauty; even if it was a lie, the Beast wanted to be loved.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_UGLY_DUCKLING_RELIC.des: Upon pickup, add an upgraded [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] and an upgraded [gold]Wrought in War[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_UGLY_DUCKLING_RELIC.fla: The ugly one lost his family, then threw himself into battle again and again. What he wished for may not have been conflict, but eternal rest.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HIGH_JUMPER_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - The High Jumpers
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HIGH_JUMPER_RELIC.descr: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{EdithFlutterPower}[/blue] [gold]Flutter[/gold]. At the end of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], take {Damage:diff()} damage.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HIGH_JUMPER_RELIC.flavo: "Want to see who can jump the highest?" The flea, the grasshopper, and the toy frog flew away from drug poisoning, all the way into the sky.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RAPUNZEL_FAIRY_TALE_REL: For the first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, your powers do not lose stacks.

Somewhere, there was a blonde girl whose hair held a charm that could rule the bodies and minds of others. Countless men and riches were drawn by the magic of her hair, and in the end, a nation was built.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WOLF_AND_LITTLE_GOATS_R: Fairy Tale - The Wolf and X Little Goats
For the first three turns, your Block is not removed. At the start of your third turn, deal damage equal to your Block to all creatures.
Gulp! The wicked wolf ate every last goat. But when he was too full to move, the goats multiplied in his belly and escaped safely.
When you enter the next normal or elite combat, all enemies gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], then this relic becomes inactive.
An arrogant boy found a raccoon nest and dug it open. What emerged was not a raccoon, but a cruel monster thirty meters long.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SINBAD_THE_SAILOR_RELIC: At the start of combat, gain [gold]Slow[/gold].

He built his selfhood on tales of his own bravery, even abandoning the family that begged him to stop. That was how deeply he longed for adventure. Perhaps it was something close to an abnormal curiosity.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TOWN_MUSICIANS_OF_BREME: Fairy Tale - Town Musicians of Bremen
At the start of the first turn, Stun all enemies and shuffle [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] at random.
The thieves had terrible luck. The moment they heard the performance, they were blown away entirely. The increasingly confident musicians swore to make their name resound throughout the world.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_IRON_HANS_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Iron Hans
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_IRON_HANS_RELIC.flavor: The war machine sleeping beneath the earth awakened once more and emerged under the dazzling sun. This weapon named Hans is the perfect embodiment of humanity's aggressive nature.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FLANDERS_DOG_RELIC.titl: Fairy Tale - A Dog of Flanders
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FLANDERS_DOG_RELIC.desc: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{FlandersTrackingPower}[/blue] [gold]Hunt[/gold]. While you have [gold]Weak[/gold], damage you take is multiplied by [blue]{WeakDamageTakenMultiplier}[/blue].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FLANDERS_DOG_RELIC.flav: The old dog forgot that it had already devoured its beloved master, and now wanders in search of boys who resemble Nello, inviting each one into its stomach.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_LITTLE_PRINCE_RELIC.des: At the end of turn [blue]{TriggerTurn}[/blue] of combat, all creatures take [blue]{MeteorDamage}[/blue] damage.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_LITTLE_PRINCE_RELIC.fla: They say the kind-hearted prince became a meteor and traveled the night sky to make the rose, his only friend, shine brighter, trying to wipe out the roses of other planets.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ARMORED_KNIGHT_RELIC.ti: Fairy Tale - The Knight in Armor
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ARMORED_KNIGHT_RELIC.de: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ARMORED_KNIGHT_RELIC.fl: Meow meow, we are knights. My companions are gone, meow. But I am not lonely at all, meow. Because my armor stays with me, meow.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_KING_WITH_DONKEY_EARS_R: Fairy Tale - The King with Donkey Ears
Your attack damage against bosses is increased by [blue]{BossDamagePercent}%[/blue].
After executing all his people, the king invited donkeys like himself to replace them. They say he finally founded a kingdom of donkeys, but it perished before it could prosper.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PETER_PAN_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Peter Pan
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PETER_PAN_RELIC.descrip: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] non-[gold]Strike[/gold], non-[gold]Defend[/gold] {Cards:plural:card|cards} and remove {Cards:plural:it|them}. If fewer than [blue]{Cards}[/blue] are available, remove them all.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PETER_PAN_RELIC.selecti: Choose five non-Strike, non-Defend cards to remove.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PETER_PAN_RELIC.flavor: The eternal boy fell out of love. What should he do if he cannot even convey his affection? Right, take them to Neverland.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MONKEY_CRAB_BATTLE_RELI: Fairy Tale - The Monkey and the Crab
Upon pickup, add [gold]Greed[/gold] and [gold]Injury[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
The cunning monkey stole the persimmon and killed the mother crab. Before long, a child was born from the mother's corpse and cried out for revenge.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GREEDY_DOG_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - The Greedy Dog
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GREEDY_DOG_RELIC.descri: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] one of the highest-rarity non-Ancient cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [gold]Greed[/gold]. If multiple cards share that rarity, choose one at random.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GREEDY_DOG_RELIC.flavor: The ugly dog reflected on the water sneered, "Greed never loses. Strip everything bare with those fangs!"
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TORTOISE_AND_HARE_RELIC: Fairy Tale - The Tortoise and the Hare
There were two maddened knights. They were rivals, and also comrades. "Let us compete. Which of us can butcher, violate, and deceive more people?"
At the start of each of your turns, automatically play [gold]Anger[/gold] a number of times equal to the current turn number.

This world is made of deceiving and being deceived, killing and being killed, revenge giving birth to more revenge. Better to burn it all to ash. So realized the tanuki sinking into the water with the mud boat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ROBIN_HOOD_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Robin Hood
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ROBIN_HOOD_RELIC.descri: At the start of each turn, if you have not lost HP this combat, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ROBIN_HOOD_RELIC.flavor: His beauty captivated all, men and women alike, and drew many lovers to him. The life of Robin the Strider came to an end at the hands of a woman driven mad by jealousy.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WHITE_RABBIT_OF_INABA_R: Fairy Tale - The Black Rabbit of Inaba
Upon pickup, obtain [gold]Black Rabbit's Hand Mirror[/gold].
My father prayed to a god, only to be horribly used by that god. I will never walk the same path as my father.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DADDY_LONG_LEGS_RELIC.d: At the start of each of the first three turns of combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DADDY_LONG_LEGS_RELIC.f: His unending silence and outstretched arms made us feel comfort even as they frightened us...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_THE_BOY_WHO_CRIED_WOLF_: Fairy Tale - The Boy Who Cried Wolf

At the start of your first turn, gain [blue]{FirstTurnStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the start of your second turn, gain [blue]{SecondTurnStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the start of your third turn, lose all [gold]Strength[/gold].
The wolf truly came, but no one was willing to believe him anymore.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CANDY_HOUSE_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Candy House
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CANDY_HOUSE_RELIC.descr: At the start of combat, shuffle [gold]Sweet Candy[/gold], [gold]Bitter Candy[/gold], and [gold]Hallucinogenic Candy[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] at random positions.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CANDY_HOUSE_RELIC.flavo: The siblings' parents were cold and never showed even the slightest love. Unable to endure the abuse and abandonment, the two finally killed their parents.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SNOW_QUEEN_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - The Snow Queen
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SNOW_QUEEN_RELIC.descri: At the start of combat, apply [gold]Slow[/gold] to all enemies.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SNOW_QUEEN_RELIC.flavor: My love cannot be expressed with words and illustrations. In this sealed pure-white world, there are only the two of us. No one can interfere. From now on, stay by my side forever. I will never let you leave alive again.
Upon pickup, add [gold]Mermaid's Tear[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
One day, the mermaid princess fell in love with a prince who appeared by the sea. That love, impossible to return, swelled until a tsunami struck the prince's kingdom.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_UNNAMED_FAIRY_TALE_BOOK: After winning [blue]{Nodes}[/blue] normal or elite combat(s), gain a random Fairy Tale. The same Fairy Tale cannot be gained twice in one run.
No name is written on the pages, only stories without endings.
At the start of combat, shuffle [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Winterbell[/gold] cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Winterbell[/gold] cards into random positions in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DREAM_OF_KADATH_RELIC.d: At rest sites, you can only [gold]Rest[/gold]. Resting heals an additional [green]30%[/green] and randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
When you choose [gold]Rest[/gold], heal an additional [green]30%[/green] of your Max HP and randomly [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DREAM_OF_KADATH_RELIC.a: Dream of Kadath: Heal an additional 30% of your Max HP and randomly upgrade {Cards} cards.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DREAM_OF_KADATH_RELIC.f: Please return to a beautiful reality.
Below [green]50%[/green] HP, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}; the first trigger each combat grants [blue]{RegenPower}[/blue] [gold]Regeneration[/gold].
At the start of your turn, if your HP is below [green]50%[/green], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. The first time this triggers each combat, gain [blue]{RegenPower}[/blue] [gold]Regeneration[/gold].
That is exactly why I must step away.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_NODE_RIBBON_RELIC.title: White Rabbit's Hairband
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_NODE_RIBBON_RELIC.descr: At the end of your turn, if incoming attacks would kill you, take an extra turn. Triggers once each combat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_NODE_RIBBON_RELIC.detai: If the total incoming enemy attack damage is greater than or equal to your current HP, Block, Plating, and Osty's current HP combined, immediately take an extra turn at the end of your turn. Triggers once each combat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WHITE_QUEEN_SOLDIER_REL: Change the first [blue]5[/blue] rows of this act into White Queen trials.

Upon pickup, change the first [blue]5[/blue] map rows of this act into trials: [blue]4[/blue] normal combats and [blue]1[/blue] elite combat. Existing paths are preserved. Complete all trials to promote into the [gold]White Queen[/gold].
A pawn that crosses the endgame becomes a queen.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WHITE_QUEEN_PROMOTION_R: You may freely choose the next map node any number of times.
Please return to a beautiful reality.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_UNICORN_ROYAL_CREST_REL: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]; counterattack when enemy attacks deal no unblocked damage.

At the start of combat, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Whenever an enemy attack deals no unblocked damage to you or Osty, immediately deal counterattack damage equal to that attack.
Let us protect an equal and pure world together.
Prevent enemies from gaining defensive effects; when an enemy gains a buff, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
Enemies cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold], [gold]Buffer[/gold], [gold]Plating[/gold], or [gold]Intangible[/gold]. Whenever an enemy gains a buff, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
Only those who break through by their own strength can be called strong.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUILL_PEN_RELIC.title: Fairy-Tale Author's Quill
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUILL_PEN_RELIC.descrip: Upon pickup, add [gold]Power of Rewrite[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUILL_PEN_RELIC.flavor: I will never accept a story like this.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_ALBUM_RELIC.d: At the start of each turn, reduce the cost of a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue] for this combat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_ALBUM_RELIC.f: I am a THINKER, I CAN BREAK IT DOWN
Upon pickup, add [gold]Red Queen's Looking Glass[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Cards removed by the Looking Glass do not enter the [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] and do not trigger exhaust-related effects.
...Go back... Hurry and turn back... hurry... go back...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CAT_COLLAR_RELIC.title: Pet Cat's Collar
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CAT_COLLAR_RELIC.descri: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. [gold]Transform[/gold] them into [gold]Cheshire Cat's Smile[/gold] and [gold]Dinah's Bite[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CAT_COLLAR_RELIC.select: Choose two cards to transform into Cheshire Cat cards.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CAT_COLLAR_RELIC.flavor: Thank you for your hard work, Dinah...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_DICE_RELIC.de: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}; all cards' damage and block values randomly fluctuate by up to [blue]{RollRange}[/blue] in combat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_DICE_RELIC.ev: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}; all cards' damage and block values randomly fluctuate by up to [blue]{RollRange}[/blue] in combat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_DICE_RELIC.di: At the start of each turn, all cards' damage and block values randomly fluctuate by up to [blue]{RollRange}[/blue] for that turn. This fluctuation only affects damage and block values. If at least [blue]1/3[/blue] of flippable cards roll [blue]+{RollRange}[/blue], gain [gold]Grand Success[/gold]. This easter egg can trigger once per run.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_DICE_RELIC.se: Choose a card to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_RIBBON_RELIC.desc: Revive on death and gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Triggers only once.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_RIBBON_RELIC.deta: When you die, revive at full HP and gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Triggers only once.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_RIBBON_RELIC.flav: Grip your weapon tightly. I am by your side.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_CURSE_RELIC.title: 蟇?ｋ蟆大･ｳ縺溘
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_CURSE_RELIC.descr: [gold]Transform[/gold] all [gold]Curses[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [gold]雋ｴ譁ｹ繧呈?縺[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_CURSE_RELIC.flavo: ...The animals are laughing happily, and the flowers are singing nursery rhymes in beautiful voices. This is the dreamland that belongs only to us.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_COVENANT_OF_PRICKETT_RE: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, gain a rare card reward.
Please treat all your time and memories with me as a dream, and forget them.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_SOLDIER_RELIC: Change the first [blue]5[/blue] rows of this act into Red Queen trials.

Upon pickup, change the first [blue]5[/blue] map rows of this act into trials: [blue]3[/blue] normal combats and [blue]2[/blue] elite combats. Existing paths are preserved. Complete all trials to promote into the [gold]Red Queen[/gold].
A pawn that crosses the endgame becomes a queen.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_PROMOTION_REL: At the start of non-Boss combats, set all enemies' current HP to [blue]1[/blue].
You can still escape now. You can return to reality...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DODO_RUN_RELIC.title: Dodo Run
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DODO_RUN_RELIC.descript: When entering a non-Boss combat, if your HP is below [blue]{Health}[/blue], skip that combat. Triggers only once.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DODO_RUN_RELIC.flavor: Run as you please! Wander everywhere in this country!
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WORM_SMOKE_RELIC.title: Caterpillar Smoke
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WORM_SMOKE_RELIC.descri: At rest sites, you may inhale Caterpillar smoke to spend Max HP, choose a card, and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it without consuming your rest-site option.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_WORM_SMOKE_RELIC.flavor: Hee... This sensation has already been seared into your brain, hasn't it?
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RETHINK_POKER_RELIC.des: Upon pickup, gain the Gold left from your previous run and choose [blue]1[/blue] of up to [blue]3[/blue] cards from your previous deck to add into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RETHINK_POKER_RELIC.sel: Choose a card to add into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RETHINK_POKER_RELIC.fla: Poker? I am no child anymore. -Queen of Hearts Lorina
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RAPUNZEL_FAVOR_RELIC.de: Draw [blue]{DrawLoss}[/blue] fewer cards each turn; every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, take an extra turn.
Draw [blue]{DrawLoss}[/blue] fewer cards each turn. Every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, take an extra turn. Turn count persists between combats.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RAPUNZEL_FAVOR_RELIC.fl: I truly... truly do feel that way about you...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_LITTLE_MERMAID_FAVOR_RE: Lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP; gain {Energy:energyIcons()} each turn.
Upon pickup, lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} each turn.
Ahh, please speak eternal love within my belly...!
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BAPHOMET_FAVOR_RELIC.de: You cannot gain Energy; cards that cost Energy cost that much HP instead; [gold]X[/gold]-cost cards resolve as [blue]{XValue}[/blue].

Your maximum Energy becomes [blue]0[/blue], and you cannot gain Energy. When you manually play a card that costs Energy, lose HP equal to its displayed cost. [gold]X[/gold]-cost cards resolve as [blue]{XValue}[/blue] and make you lose [blue]{XValue}[/blue] HP.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BAPHOMET_FAVOR_RELIC.fl: Cast everything away, offer your life, and receive love.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PRINCESS_FROG_FAVOR_REL: When you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply the same debuff an additional time; [green]{Chance}%[/green] chance to backfire.

Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply the same debuff an additional time. Each trigger has a [green]{Chance}%[/green] chance to also give yourself [blue]{Penalty}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], or [gold]Frail[/gold].
Lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]; halve damage from enemy attacks.
At the start of combat, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Damage from enemy attacks is halved.
At the start of your turn, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the end of your turn, remove all debuffs.
At the start of each turn, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the end of each turn, remove all debuffs.
I see... I am only a creation built from countless lies...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HLANITH_WINE_RELIC.desc: Upon pickup, add [gold]Hlanith Wine[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HLANITH_WINE_RELIC.flav: Fine wine produced in the trade city of Hlanith.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_STAGE_END_RELIC.title: Stage End
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_STAGE_END_RELIC.descrip: Upon pickup, add [gold]Stage End[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ETERNAL_VANITY_RELIC.de: All cards gain [gold]Void[/gold]. Each turn, gain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Void {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
After entering combat, give [gold]Void[/gold] to all cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Each turn, gain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards} with [gold]Void[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ETERNAL_VANITY_RELIC.fl: The indifference of the universe is the greatest terror.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GIFT_OF_CHAOS_RELIC.des: Choose up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attack/Skill cards and fuse them into [gold]Chaos Fusion[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GIFT_OF_CHAOS_RELIC.sel: Choose up to 3 non-X-cost Attack or Skill cards to fuse.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GIFT_OF_CHAOS_RELIC.fus: Materials are limited to non-X-cost Attack and Skill cards. The fused card inherits the material cards' costs and keywords, randomly determines its type, and randomly keeps up to one enchantment. When played, it plays all material card effects in random order against random targets.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GIFT_OF_CHAOS_RELIC.fla: You are all my adorable jewels.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MYSTERY_OF_NIGHT_SKY_RE: Each turn, [green]{Chance}%[/green] chance to play your first card an additional time.
Each turn, there is a [green]{Chance}%[/green] chance to play your first card an additional time.
The mystery woven beyond the night sky itself.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_A.title: Violence Demon's Film Reel
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_A.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{ViolenceDemonPower}[/blue] [gold]Violence Demon[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_A.details.desc: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{ViolenceDemonPower}[/blue] [gold]Violence Demon[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_A.flavor: Love has many forms☆ ...The violent kind is a little hard to understand, though!
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_B.title: Killer's Film Reel
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_B.description: The first time you hit a non-attacking enemy, Stun it and apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] Vulnerable.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_B.details.desc: In combat, the first time you hit each enemy that does not intend to attack, [gold]Stun[/gold] it and apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_OLD_FILM_B.flavor: Someday, someday I will take you out of here.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MARGARET_RELIC.title: Duchess's Menu
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MARGARET_RELIC.descript: When you receive card rewards, you may choose to [gold]Supply[/gold]. After [blue]{Supplies}[/blue] Supplies, gain rewards based on total score.
Supply records the rarity score of all cards in that card reward: Common [blue]1[/blue], Uncommon [blue]2[/blue], Rare [blue]3[/blue]. Total score no higher than [blue]12[/blue]: gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold and an uncommon card reward. [blue]13[/blue]-[blue]18[/blue]: gain [gold]{MidGold}[/gold] Gold and a rare card reward. Higher than [blue]18[/blue]: gain [gold]{HighGold}[/gold] Gold and two rare card rewards.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MARGARET_RELIC.flavor: ...Perfect timing. I have always wanted to eat you!!
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HORRIFYING_GLUTTON_RELI: Choose an Attack card to enchant with Feeding.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUEEN_TART_RELIC.title: Queen's Tart
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUEEN_TART_RELIC.descri: The next event in Act [blue]2[/blue] will become [gold]Queen of Hearts[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUEEN_TART_RELIC.flavor: Don't tell her, absolutely keep it secret. This is a secret.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RED_QUEEN_GUILLOTINE_RE: Upon pickup, add [gold]Queen of Hearts' Guillotine[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Heads off first thing in the morning, heads off at tea time, heads off after dinner too!
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TWIN_WAX_STATUE_RELIC.d: Choose a card that has another card with the same name, then enchant [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of them with [gold]Twin[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TWIN_WAX_STATUE_RELIC.s: Choose a card that has another card with the same name, then enchant two of them with Twin.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TWIN_WAX_STATUE_RELIC.f: We have always loved each other. Please do not separate us.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_LONELY_WAX_STATUE_RELIC: Because we have loved each other since the moment we were born... twins.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MINI_SNOWMAN_RELIC.desc: Upon pickup, remove all card enchantments. At the start of combat, afflict all cards with [gold]Evil Qi[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MINI_SNOWMAN_RELIC.flav: Earnest, straightforward love... sounds so boring.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FRIENDLY_SLIME_NOD_RELI: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attack or Skill {Cards:plural:card|cards}. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [gold]Dissolve[/gold].
Choose an Attack or Skill card to enchant with Dissolve.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FRIENDLY_SLIME_HANDSHAK: Upon pickup, take [red]{HpLoss}[/red] damage, then choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attack or Skill {Cards:plural:card|cards}. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [gold]Dissolve[/gold].
Choose two Attack or Skill cards to enchant with Dissolve.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_FRIENDLY_SLIME_HUG_RELI: Upon pickup, take [red]{HpLoss}[/red] damage, then choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attack or Skill {Cards:plural:card|cards}. [gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them} with [gold]Dissolve[/gold].
Choose three Attack or Skill cards to enchant with Dissolve.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MERCURY_RELIC.title: Mercury
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_MERCURY_RELIC.flavor: Lick mercury for communication facing the universe!
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SUSPICIOUS_HAT_RELIC.de: Always copies the effect of your rightmost non-Ancient relic.
Only copies the rightmost relic in your relic bar whose rarity is not Ancient. If no relic qualifies, it has no effect.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ANGEL_FEATHER_RELIC.des: The first time you take unblocked damage each combat, gain that much [gold]Vigor[/gold]. Transforms upon entering Act [blue]2[/blue].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ANGEL_FEATHER_RELIC.fla: One angel is enough to save everyone♪
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_QUESTION_ANGEL_FEATHER_: When you take unblocked damage, gain that much [gold]Vigor[/gold]. Transforms upon entering Act [blue]3[/blue].
Those detestable demon wings growing from my body...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BRUTALIZING_ANGEL_FEATH: When you take unblocked damage, gain that much [gold]Vigor[/gold]. After the first time you are damaged each combat, attacks that deal unblocked damage heal HP, up to the amount of that damage taken.
No matter how much they are torn or shredded, they grow back again and again...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_KNIGHT_CHESS_PIECE_RELI: Obtained by facing the Red Knight. When choosing the next map node, you may move [blue]1[/blue] column left or right any number of times.
Those are the rules of the game.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_ALICE_HANDKERCHIEF_RELI: In the first [blue]5[/blue] non-Ancient nodes of the next act, if a node is a combat node, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] at the start of combat.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_PUMPKIN_HAND_MIRROR_REL: Upon pickup, add [gold]Orr's Reflection[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The counter shows current [gold]SAN[/gold].
The mirror does not always reflect yourself.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_RABBIT_HAND_MIRROR_RELI: Upon pickup, add [gold]Banai's Reflection[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The counter shows current [gold]SAN[/gold].
The mirror does not always reflect yourself.
Upon pickup, add [gold]Holmes' Reflection[/gold] and [gold]Jack the Ripper's Reflection[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The next act will have a path with only normal and elite combats. The counter shows current [gold]SAN[/gold].
The mirror does not always reflect yourself.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_EDITH_RING_RELIC.title: Edith's Ring
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_EDITH_RING_RELIC.descri: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Flutter[/gold]. This effect is removed at the start of your second turn.
Upon pickup, add [gold]Liddell's Reflection[/gold] into your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The first time you take damage in combat, reflect that much damage to the source. The counter shows current [gold]SAN[/gold].
There is a road in the mirror that never ends.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_NORTH_WIND_AND_SUN_RELI: Fairy Tale - The North Wind and the Sun

Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] up to [blue]{Count}[/blue] Attack cards into random Skill cards and upgrade them, and up to [blue]{Count}[/blue] Skill cards into random Attack cards and upgrade them. Afterward, you cannot heal.
One day, the North Wind and the Sun had a quarrel. They argued for three days and three nights, unleashing typhoons and scorching heat upon the land, destroying the villages around them.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SNOW_WHITE_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Snow White
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SNOW_WHITE_RELIC.descri: The first card you play each combat is copied twice: one copy is added into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], and one is added into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SNOW_WHITE_RELIC.flavor: The stepmother queen envied Snow White's beauty and nearly killed her several times. And just like Snow White, she too thought of killing her stepmother to become the fairest in all the land.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CINDERELLA_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - Cinderella
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CINDERELLA_RELIC.descri: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] all Common cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [gold]Ashes[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_CINDERELLA_RELIC.flavor: The ash-clad princess appeared before women yearning for love and status, leading them to the ball. But they did not know that the price of a dream come true is the loss of their very soul...
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TURNIP_RELIC.title: Fairy Tale - The Giant Turnip
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TURNIP_RELIC.descriptio: Your next card reward will fuse all reward cards into a single fused card added into your [gold]Deck[/gold]. If there are fewer than 2 fusable cards, this relic expires.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TURNIP_RELIC.fusionDeta: Materials are limited to non-X-cost Attack and Skill cards. The fused card inherits the material cards' costs and keywords, randomly determines its type, and randomly keeps up to one enchantment. When played, it plays all material card effects in random order against random targets.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_TURNIP_RELIC.flavor: "Pull with all your might, pull harder!" The giant turnip, having entangled the old man, the old woman, the granddaughter, the dog, the cat, the mouse, the heroine, the king, and all the kingdom's subjects, became an enormous mass.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SLEEP_GOD_MYTH_RELIC.de: Upon pickup, choose a non-X-cost Attack or Skill card. [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [gold]Sleep[/gold] equal to its cost.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SLEEP_GOD_MYTH_RELIC.se: Choose a card to enchant with Sleep.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SLEEP_GOD_MYTH_RELIC.fl: The God of Sleep grants slumber, and with it, the power that follows awakening.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_LAKE_GOD_MYTH_RELIC.des: At the start of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue] each combat, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and gain [blue]{CorruptionPower}[/blue] [gold]Corruption[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_LAKE_GOD_MYTH_RELIC.fla: It transforms living creatures with spines, seeking to make all of Wonderland its own kin.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_DARK_GOAT_OF_THE_WOODS_: Myth - Dark Goat of the Woods

Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Select}[/blue] cards and [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with [gold]Breeding[/gold]. At the start of each turn, randomly [gold]Exhaust[/gold] 2 Breeding cards and create [blue]{Children}[/blue] Chaos Fusion children, shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].

Materials are limited to Attack and Skill cards. Each child uses one random parent's cost; each parent's effect has an independent [blue]50%[/blue] chance to be inherited. The child's type is random. When played, it plays the inherited material effects in a random order against random targets.
Her power breeds endless distorted flesh.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_GREAT_STAG_GODDESS_MYTH: Myth - Goddess of the Great Stag
Cards that have entered the Exhaust pile cost [blue]{Energy}[/blue] more. At the start of your turn, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card from the Exhaust pile and put it into your draw pile.
Her dominion was the forest's mirage, the mind's terror, and the curse that made beasts of men.
All non-boss map nodes appear as [gold]Unknown[/gold] nodes. Their contents remain unchanged.
A mass of black tentacles and night-dark flesh, shrouded in a mist that devours light. It twists the minds of living things and drags them into a sightless chaos.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_SHADOW_DEMONESS_MYTH_RE: After combat begins, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold] every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns. You cannot gain extra Energy.
An Outer God that dwells in a lightless dimension of shadow. With a gesture, she can snuff out every lamp.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BARRISTERS_PAGE_RELIC.d: Enemies begin combat with the intent they would normally use on their second turn.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BARRISTERS_PAGE_RELIC.f: Judgment came before the trial. With no reason left to live, the Barrister set out on the hunt for the Snark.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BANKERS_PAGE_RELIC.desc: Card rewards are replaced with [gold]Gold[/gold] equal to the highest shop price among the offered cards.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BANKERS_PAGE_RELIC.flav: Money meant nothing in the Snark's eyes. For that very reason, the Banker hated and feared it beyond measure.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BELLMANS_PAGE_RELIC.des: Your [gold]Deck[/gold] will always contain an even number of each card.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_BELLMANS_PAGE_RELIC.fla: The Bellman was obsessed with symmetry. For the Snark, a creature that defied all aesthetics of symmetry, he swore to hunt it until death.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HARALD_SHIPMAN_NEWS_REL: When you use a potion, heal [blue]5[/blue] HP. For each combat where you did not use a potion, lose [blue]1[/blue] Max HP at the end of combat.
Harold Shipman, a 20th-century British serial killer, killed his victims by injecting lethal doses of drugs.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_JACK_KETCH_NEWS_RELIC.d: At the start of turn [blue]{TriggerTurn}[/blue], all monsters intend to perform a heavy strike for [blue]{SlamDamage}[/blue] damage.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HELMSMANS_PAGE_RELIC.de: Stun enemies that attempt to speak to you for 1 turn.
BS_ANCIENT_RELIC_HELMSMANS_PAGE_RELIC.fl: The tearful Helmsman secretly hoped the captain would die during the hunt for the Snark, so that he might finally speak with someone.
